DIRANERSEN (BIIB080) • In May 2026 we announced topline results from the Phase 2 CELIA study evaluating diranersen, an investigational ASO therapy targeting tau, in individuals with early Alzheimer's disease.

The data, presented at the Alzheimer’s Association International Conference 2026, expand upon previously reported topline results and demonstrate a combination of meaningful clinical efficacy and robust biomarker effects, providing Phase 2 proof of concept for diranersen’s tau-directed mechanism of action.
